title: Orsen and the Horizon
author: Orsen Sterling
blurb: Jonah Ishikawa, an archaeologist's estranged child and better digger, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
